items.title: One interface. Your work context.
items.content: Synthetic example: code, sessions, usage and project knowledge are intended to come together in one personal workspace. The source tools retain their data and permissions. New adapters are connected and checked individually.

items.title: From code to a traceable review
items.content: Synthetic example: select a task, review the code draft, inspect session metadata, prepare a local review draft and make the decision in the system of record. A green connection status does not replace a substantive review and approval.

items.title: Memory with traceable sources
items.content: Synthetic example: entries include an ID, content, source, timestamp and tags. O.A. - O.S reads the explicitly linked file, shows integrity and freshness, and exports a context package. Model context is not populated automatically.

items.title: White-label colors without a separate fork
items.content: Synthetic example: name, monogram, link, accent color and light or dark theme come from a JSON configuration. Your logo can be replaced in the source code. Customer data and connection configuration belong in a private folder.
